# Auto-generated node display names

Set only `NODE_ID=n1` through `NODE_ID=n50` (plus the other deployment credentials and role/url settings already required by the project). The existing `utils/cluster.py` derives `NODE_LABEL` automatically.

Examples: `n1` = 👑 Royal Phantom; `n2` = 🔥 Inferno King; `n50` = 👑 Infinity Emperor.

`NODE_NAME` is optional and can override the automatic label; remove it from your deployment environment to use the generated name. Node IDs remain stable and are used for routing, while display labels are decorative.
